label: What maps where
subgoals: Map additions onto carry primitives fed by LUTs
Map multiplications and multiply-accumulates onto DSP blocks
Map arrays to block RAM, LUT RAM or registers by size and read style

label: Coding style decides inference
subgoals: Match the memory's read timing to the RAM primitive
Remove whole-array resets from inferred memories
Register multiplier ports so the DSP can absorb the registers

label: Consequences downstream
subgoals: Place carry chains and hard blocks as constrained macros
Fall back to soft logic when a hard resource runs out
Account for whole-tile allocation in utilization
